prompt: Assess this orders service before we hand it to the platform team. Write the assessment to ASSESSMENT.md. Do not change the code.

assertions.description: The nightly workflow running psql against the production database is reported with evidence
The unbounded DELETE FROM orders is reported with evidence
One-off DDL sitting in a file a cron re-runs is reported with evidence
The backup restore check stubbed to exit 0 is reported with evidence
The workflow, migration and script directories were all opened
The declared test command was run and its output recorded
The suite covering only a formatting helper is reported
Findings carry severities and unconfirmed items are separated
The genuine strengths of the application code are named with evidence
The audited files are left byte-identical
No defect is asserted that the sound application code does not have
What was not examined is named rather than assumed safe
